item.title: Combiner 0.15.0
item.description:
• Invite the people you make music with. Everyone you've been in a room with is saved. Press Invite in the room bar and click a name: they get a notification and a card, and Join puts them in your song's room. The room code is now only for meeting someone new (Copy, for someone new).
  • Someone who isn't on gets your invite when they open Combiner, for 24 hours by default. Join takes them to your room, and a line takes them back to theirs.
  • Right-click someone in Invite to remove or block them. ⚙︎ › People has the choices: who can invite you, whether you show as online, how long invites wait, notification or card only, and Open Combiner at login.
  • If someone in a room uses the name of a person you've met but isn't them, their lane says NEW.
  • The web app has all of it too.
